cases.task: Produce one concise operator-facing paragraph explaining that queued interactive work has priority but cannot interrupt a live accelerator lease.
cases.draft: Interactive jobs are always most important. They can interrupt any experiment immediately. The accelerator coordinator coordinates accelerator jobs. This priority rule is absolute and has no exceptions.

cases.task: Revise this into two clear sentences distinguishing durable checkpoints from warm caches without repetition.
cases.draft: A checkpoint survives a restart. A warm cache can make work faster. Checkpoints survive restarts because they are durable. Warm caches are also checkpoints, although they disappear after restarts.

cases.draft: Your edit was bad. We threw everything away. Try again and maybe use valid operations next time. The current draft might still exist.

cases.task: Turn this into a calm operational status note with no contradiction and no unsupported certainty.
